findings.title: Delete menu item can never appear in the new rule list view
findings.body: canDelete is now OR-computed from the Grafana prom-rule abilities so it can be true when only promRule is supplied (the new list view passes no rulerRule after GrafanaRuleLoader was removed), but rendering is still gated by `canDelete && rulerRule`. In GrafanaRuleListItem/RuleActionsButtons.V2 only promRule is passed, so rulerRule is undefined and Delete is never rendered for Grafana rules in the list view, even for users with delete permission. The same pattern breaks Pause at line 123 (`canPause && rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule) && ...`), so paused-state toggling is also unreachable there.

findings.title: Silence drawer can never open in the new rule list view
findings.body: AlertRuleMenu now enables Silence from the Grafana prom-rule abilities and calls handleSilence, which sets showSilenceDrawer=true here, but the drawer is only rendered when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true. In the new list view `rule` (the ruler rule) is always undefined because GrafanaRuleListItem only passes promRule, so clicking 'Silence notifications' does nothing and no drawer mounts. The check/drawer need a prom-rule based path.

findings.title: Grafana rule list items are rendered without a React key
findings.body: The `grafana` case in the rules.map() switch returns <GrafanaRuleListItem> without `key={key}`, unlike the datasource case on line 165 and the previous GrafanaRuleLoader usage which had key={key}. FilterView already computes a unique KeyedRuleWithOrigin.key to prevent duplication; without it React falls back to index reconciliation, which can reuse the wrong list-item state (menus, drawers, pause state) when the infinite-scroll list appends/reorders rules and will emit key warnings.
